description: Golden reference for metatrain PET model 'pet-mad-xs-v1.6', case 'molecule'. Energy in eV, positions in Angstrom, forces in eV/Angstrom. Total energy INCLUDES composition energies and the output scaler.
evaluation_path: metatrain.utils.io.load_model(ckpt).export() -> metatomic AtomisticModel; MetatomicCalculator(model, variants={'energy': 'None'}).compute_energy(atoms, compute_forces_and_stresses=True, per_atom=True)
notes: Generated from pet-mad-xs-v1.6.0 (lab-cosmo/upet), which uses adaptive_cutoff_method=solver -- unlike the pet-mad-xs goldens alongside it, which come from a 2026.1-era checkpoint using the legacy grid method. The two schemes choose different per-atom cutoffs, so these are a genuinely different reference, not a regenerated one.
